title: LEVERAGE-02: bounded re-rank after the rhythm + exposure-cap landings
contract: docs/sourcing_protocol.md section 3: one-at-a-time endpoint perturbation across each register row's declared interval; L2 = interval move flips an anchor verdict, L1 = moves an anchor measurably without flipping, L0 = no detectable movement in any scored output across the whole interval.
reopened_criterion: a pre-change L0 is reopened iff the row's scored channel runs through event-cohort partitioning (SHIP-RHYTHM-02) or the per-shedder contact budget (EXPO-CAP-01); natural-history, susceptibility, ascertainment and dose-response rows whose channels are unchanged stay L0 by their LEVERAGE-01 measurement

noise_gate.seed_pair: paired seeds; the noise floor is the seed-pair spread |x(seed_a) - x(seed_b)| on the baseline cell
noise_gate.measurable_movement: a scored quantity moves iff the paired deltas d_i = endpoint_i - baseline_i have the same sign AND |mean(d)| exceeds the baseline seed-pair spread; if the baseline pair is degenerate (spread 0) any same-sign nonzero paired movement counts
noise_gate.verdict_flip: an anchor verdict (PASS/FAIL or hit/miss) changes between the baseline cell and an endpoint cell; an anchor undefined at baseline and defined at the endpoint is movement, not a flip, unless its unconditional channel (A8/A9 or H1/H2/H3) flips
noise_gate.classification: L2 if any verdict flips at either endpoint; else L1 if any scored quantity shows measurable movement at either endpoint; else L0

scored_outputs.noro: row_from_summary -> summarise_cell -> verdicts(era=pre): A1_ever_ill_passenger, A2_ill_per_infected, A5_passenger_crew_ratio, A8 (pax/crew incidence bands), A9 posting probability; movement quantities: ever_ill_attack_rate_passenger, infection_attack_rate_passenger, reported_case_attack_rate_passenger, reported_case_attack_rate_crew, A5 per-seed ratio, vsp_posted, attack_rate, peak_epoch
scored_outputs.covid: HullObservables per hull per seed: positive_share (H1 target 0.5899 +/-0.1 on greg_mortimer), asymptomatic_share (H2 target 0.8125 +/-0.1), H3 placement (worst hull positive_share > IQR upper quartile, paired by seed index across hulls), plus reported-onset counts; movement quantities: positive_share per hull, asymptomatic_share, recorded_onsets per hull

noro.note: the exercised anchor cell: renewal boarding (~0.4% derived prevalence) at the full classic complement, 7-day voyage; same construction as the bounded-screen/admissible-region cells

covid.note: the v6 fit arm; theta held at the fitted value except on the cov_theta axis, whose endpoints are the declared fit-grid bounds

transforms.field: assign endpoint to a dotted path under scope
transforms.range_point: collapse a [lo,hi] range field to a point [v,v] at the endpoint
transforms.peak_to: shift shedding_curve_log10 additively so its peak equals the endpoint (shape preserved)
transforms.shift_peak: shift shedding_curve_log10 circularly-free (edge-clamped) so its argmax day index equals the endpoint
transforms.decline_slope: rebuild the post-peak tail of shedding_curve_log10 as peak - slope*(d - d_peak), floored at 0
transforms.asym_offset: shift asymptomatic_shedding_log10 so its peak sits `endpoint` log10 below the symptomatic peak
transforms.survival_point: replace illness_duration's survival table with a degenerate table: all hosts ill exactly `endpoint` days
transforms.median_field: set dict field .median to the endpoint, widening min/max only to bracket it
transforms.renewal_prevalence: write boarding.renewal.case_incidence_per_1000_py (both roles) so the renewal-derived boarding prevalence equals the endpoint: inc = prev * 1000 * (1-never_symptomatic_fraction) * 365.25 / detectable_duration_days
transforms.incubation_median: set incubation.median_days to the endpoint and relax the truncation bound on the endpoint's side by 1e-9 relative so the median stays strictly inside
transforms.theta: covid only: run the hull at theta=endpoint instead of the fitted value
transforms.obs_vectors: covid only: set observation_model ascertainment vectors (eligibility + reporting rungs) to all-0 or all-1 as one whole-vector endpoint
transforms.rhythm_event_field: write rhythm.event_overrides.<class>.<field> = endpoint for every listed event class ('*' hits all dealt events)
transforms.asleep_share: rescale the shipped 24-tuple asleep_in_cabin_share so its night plateau equals the endpoint
transforms.voyage_sea_contact: enable voyage effects with a one-entry all-sea-day itinerary (resolve_epoch_state short-circuits on an empty itinerary) and set defaults.sea_day.contact_rate_multiplier = endpoint
transforms.activity_rate_block: write every CONTACT-ARCH-01 activity rate to {passenger: endpoint/24, crew: crew_endpoint/24} per hour
